project_type: Water park roofing and daylight integration system
system_type: Hybrid ZIP, Polycarbonate & Sandwich Panel Roofing System
challenge: Execution of a large recreational roofing system requiring balanced daylight transmission, controlled indoor ventilation, waterproof roof integration, and coordinated installation between transparent roofing sections, operable roof openings, and insulated sandwich panel areas.
sipanel_solution: SIPANEL engineered a hybrid roofing solution combining transparent daylight-transmitting roof sections, automated operable ventilation openings, and insulated sandwich panel systems to optimize thermal performance, indoor comfort, and architectural integration.
engineering_decision: Engineering teams developed coordinated roof zoning strategies, automatic ventilation opening integration details, waterproofing transitions between transparent and insulated sections, and structural support layouts to ensure reliable long-term performance and environmental control.
execution_detail: Installation teams executed phased coordination procedures for transparent roof panels, automated opening systems, drainage continuity, waterproof sealing, and sandwich panel integration while maintaining alignment precision and operational testing standards.
measured_result: Successful delivery of an integrated recreational roofing system providing controlled natural daylight, reliable automated roof ventilation, thermal insulation efficiency, and long-term waterproof performance.
primary_message: Integrated hybrid roofing systems combining daylight control, automated ventilation, and insulated sandwich panel performance.

metrics.execution_focus: Daylight integration and automated ventilation performance
